description: The light host's one window. Core's own defaults — events for the page's listen, and the window and path reads the desktop face's shell makes. The opener's URL grant and its default scope — the desktop's exact pair, never `opener:default` — because a press that leaves the app — the desktop face's `Open on …` on a tablet past 1024px, and any other link out of the app — goes through `@tauri-apps/plugin-opener` (`packages/ui/lib/core/tauri.ts`, which `packages/ui/lib/core/index.ts` picks as this host's way out). No dialog or fs permission: both are used from Rust only, as the desktop's dialogs are.
